test_title: PYST 69: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A brass hemispherical bowl has an inner diameter of 10.5 cm. if the cost of tin-plating the inner surface is 15 per 100 cm², what will be the total cost (in whole number) of plating the inside of the bowl?
solution:
**Given:**

Inner diameter = 10.5

Cost = 15 per 100 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Radius = diameter ÷ 2

Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2 × π × r²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Radius = 10.5 ÷ 2 = 5.25

⇒ Area = 2 × π × (5.25)²

⇒ = 2 × (22/7) × 27.5625

⇒ = (44/7) × 27.5625

⇒ = 44 × 3.9375

⇒ = 173.25

⇒ Cost per cm² = 15 ÷ 100 = 0.15

⇒ Total cost = 173.25 × 0.15

⇒ = 25.9875

⇒ ≈ 26

**∴ The correct answer is 26.**
